cards.title: Two kinds of resources
cards.idea: Some natural resources are present in unlimited amounts, while others are limited and can run out.

interaction.prompt: Tap the resource you think can never run out: sunlight or coal

cards.reveal: Sunlight is available in unlimited amounts, so it can never run out. Coal is limited and will run out one day.

cards.title: Inexhaustible resources
cards.idea: Inexhaustible resources are present in unlimited quantity and are not likely to be exhausted by human use.

interaction.prompt: Tap all that are inexhaustible: air, sunlight, petroleum, wind

cards.reveal: Air, sunlight and wind are inexhaustible. Petroleum is limited and will be used up, so it is not inexhaustible.

cards.title: Exhaustible resources
cards.idea: Exhaustible resources are limited in nature and can be used up by human activities.

interaction.prompt: Tap the exhaustible resource: forests and wildlife, or sunlight

cards.reveal: Forests and wildlife are limited and can be exhausted if overused. Coal, petroleum and natural gas are also exhaustible.

cards.title: How fossil fuels form
cards.idea: Coal, petroleum and natural gas took millions of years to form, which is why they are exhaustible.

interaction.prompt: Tap the reason fossil fuels are treated as exhaustible

cards.reveal: They form from buried remains of plants and animals over millions of years. They are used far faster than they form, so they can run out.

cards.title: Why it matters
cards.idea: Because exhaustible resources cannot be quickly replaced, we must use them carefully and prefer inexhaustible sources where possible.

interaction.prompt: Tap the wiser choice for daily electricity: solar power or burning more coal

cards.reveal: Solar power uses sunlight, an inexhaustible resource, so it helps conserve the limited coal we have.

workbook.prompt: Which of these is an inexhaustible resource
Resources that are limited and can be used up by human activities are called ________ resources.
Why are coal and petroleum considered exhaustible
options: They are found only under the sea
They took millions of years to form and are used faster than they form
They are made fresh in factories every day
workbook.answer: They took millions of years to form and are used faster than they form

boss.prompt: A village replaces its diesel generator with a solar panel. Which idea best explains why this helps
options: Diesel is inexhaustible so it should be saved
Solar uses sunlight, an inexhaustible resource, reducing use of limited fuels
Sunlight will run out faster than diesel
boss.answer: Solar uses sunlight, an inexhaustible resource, reducing use of limited fuels

boss.prompt: Air, sunlight and wind can never be used up by humans, so they are called ________ resources.

options: Forests are inexhaustible because trees grow back instantly
Natural gas is inexhaustible because it is a gas
Forests can be exhausted if cut faster than they can regrow
boss.answer: Forests can be exhausted if cut faster than they can regrow
